entities.text: Tree yard: parents and children at runtime. Left, turret-a is a turret prefab (base, barrel and a sight sensor) whose parts sit under the instance's node and move with it; tower is the same turret built from plain entities, a node with a base solid under it and a barrel marker with a collider under the base. carrier is a marker on a turning yoyo tween: game code that instantiates a turret under it (parent: carrier) gets one that swings with it. tilt is a node at 30 degrees carrying tilt-turret, a second turret instance, leaning with it. crate is a dynamic prop; crate-eye, its child, is a second collider on the crate's body. lift is a follower carrying deck, a child solid, and rider (hero-side) stands on the deck and is carried to lift-stop. room-drop's spawner places a room, whose doorway and latches are nested prefabs; when its lifeMs ends the room's node goes and takes them with it, and the spawner places another. Right, arm, forearm and hand are a three-level chain: arm swings on a tween and the two below it follow, each turned 30 degrees further.
